subject.title: Feature Request: Batch API support for background tasks

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class delayed provider Batch API lifecycle for agent turns, and which background entry points should support it initially?
rationale: The source establishes that the capability is missing, but it cannot determine the permanent lifecycle, persistence, delivery, fallback, provider-eligibility, and public configuration contract.

options.title: Design a shared lifecycle
options.body: Add one generic provider and plugin delayed-turn contract and initially expose it to a deliberately selected set of latency-tolerant background paths.

options.title: Start with isolated cron
options.body: Scope the first contract and opt-in to isolated cron agent turns, then evaluate heartbeat, sessions, and subagents after operational proof.

options.title: Keep agent turns real-time
options.body: Decline a core lifecycle and document that external provider-batch workflows cannot retain the complete OpenClaw agent loop.

recommendation.title: Design a shared lifecycle
recommendation.body: Add one generic provider and plugin delayed-turn contract and initially expose it to a deliberately selected set of latency-tolerant background paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The live discussion and available provider-contract history make steipete the strongest available owner for this cross-boundary product and API choice.
